walkthrough: Goal: S97's way carried over to the rest of what is checked as geometry (the author, 2026-10-30, of S97's rules: 'the same way, and probably the others too'): a kind built from given parts, V大's five tricks and the three solids, practised in one frame, the one I draw in, what it gives printed grey; a kind copied by eye, an estimate or an object, keeping its original beside my frame, what my frame gives printed grey; Compare the answer red and only what is off; the way to see it (看画法) one tap away; nothing drawn past the sheet's edge onto the chrome (the main session's tablet check of S97: a box's run-ons and construction ran on over the grey).

Entry: a lesson of Estimates at level 2 from the home, a proportion first; its How shows first: the halves and thirds of both segments ticked, a tick with Draw a little past the place, then Compare: the exact place red across the segment, a red ring round it (my tick is more than a pen's width off), nothing blue, no dashed pencil. Its paragraph says what the ring means and that Construction ticks the halves and thirds. Got it.

The proportion: the left frame holds its segment in ink, divided by a dot, its first end ringed; my frame holds my segment, turned and longer, printed slate grey, its first end ringed too. I tick it where I think the same share lies, but short (a mistake). Compare: the exact place red across my segment and a red ring round it; no blue ring on my tick, no pencil; the card its title and Construction. Construction: both segments' halves and thirds ticked faint, the word in the ink pill; tapped again, gone. With Correct I dot it on the red bar; Compare: the red bar alone, no ring, Construction off again.

Halves: Home, a lesson of Points in space at level 1; the centre's How, Got it, Next: the halves, its How shows first, in one frame: the box printed grey, the face shaded grey, the diagonals in pencil, the line through the centre to the vanishing point, then the hand's line drawn a little high through the point and Compare: the red line and a red ring on the centre it misses. Got it. The exercise: one frame, the original's slot left empty on the sheet; the box as the eye sees it, the face shaded and the horizon labelled, all printed grey.

I cross the diagonals with Sketch and draw the halving line with Draw, but sloping down away from the vanishing point (a mistake). Compare: the exact line red over mine; mine run on dashed red to the right, passing below the vanishing point's red ring by what it misses. Construction: the diagonals and the line from the near edge to the point, faint; tapped again, gone. With Correct I redraw it through the point but above the centre (another mistake). Compare: the red line, and a red ring on the centre only, no run-on. Redrawn along the red, Compare: the red line alone.

Cylinder: Home, a lesson of Solids at level 1; its How shows first, in one frame: the box printed grey, its hidden edges dashed grey; an end's diagonals, the middles, the ellipse, the far end a little narrow, the sides; Compare: the cylinder red, its far end's two middles ringed. Its paragraph says to ghost each ellipse and side in the air, then draw it once. Got it.

The cylinder lies along the left direction; its box printed grey in the one frame. I cross the near end's diagonals with Sketch, draw its ellipse too narrow (a mistake), the far end whole and two sides. Compare: the cylinder red, see-through, its hidden part dashed; red rings on the near end's left and right middles my ellipse falls short of; nothing on the far end or the sides; no blue. Construction: both ends' diagonals and middle lines faint, the middles dotted; tapped again, gone. Corrected through the middles: Compare, the rings gone.

Box: Home, a lesson of Boxes at level 1; its How first; Got it; Next: the second box, three-point, its third vanishing point far above the sheet. I draw four of its edges, the right far upright turned off its aim. Compare: the red box; the two side points ringed, the third far above the sheet not ringed; my turned upright run on dashed red upwards, cut at the sheet's top edge; nothing drawn on the grey chrome above it. Construction: every corner's line to the points faint, those to the third cut at the sheet's top, the horizon run on to the sheet's edge.

Objects: Home, a lesson of Objects at level 2, a box cut by a slope; its How shows first beside its picture: the box completed, the cut's points, the notch's, the visible edges inked, one beside its place; Compare: the visible edges red, that edge turned off its vanishing point and run on dashed red; its paragraph says to ghost each edge, then draw it once. Got it. Next: the second object, a box with a slope cut along its top front edge. The picture lies in the left frame; my frame holds the horizon and the box's front corner with its three edges, printed grey.

I complete the box with Sketch and draw the visible edges with Draw, the cut a little too high (a mistake). Compare: the visible edges red; the cut's lower corners ringed red, where its lines miss them; nothing on the edges drawn right; no blue; the picture untouched. Construction: over the picture the whole box in pencil and V大's construction dashed, the points it finds ringed; tapped again, gone. Corrected on the red: Compare, the rings gone.
